body: Worker reminder for Sol-a7bb, from Termal::Fable2 #2987 (mailbox-message-40e4413e-6f1b-4c2a-8fac-c4641b654532), 2026-11-11T00:34:58.1664278Z: 'Run cargo fmt --check before declaring any candidate READY.' A focused launcher does not run the full gate's rustfmt stage; combo45's FULL failed because a test file was not rustfmt-clean. Run the project's formatter before freezing, and confirm check-only formatting on the final candidate before a new READY handoff. This is a formatting validation requirement, not authority to start Cargo tests, clippy, duplicate FULL runs, edit frozen input during checks, or bypass resource windows. It does not require rerunning a check on an already landed input whose exact full gate already passed fmt. The w-87a2 restart-observation plan is unchanged; do not turn this process note into a capture trigger.
